# P05 Requests and questions

- Requirement: Required for all types
- Placement: The relevant discussion in the body
- Narrative role: Connects the preceding explanation to the judgment needed from the other side and follow-up action.
- Author: Request or handoff author
- Reviewer: The sender confirms the required result; the recipient confirms the question, scope and acceptance of responsibility directed to them
- Check: Are requests, questions and implementation proposals distinguished? Will the answer determine the requesting side’s next action?

<!-- body:start -->
## What we need you to confirm

We want to confirm [the judgment needed now]. What we know covers [scope]; we do not yet know [what can only be checked in the other side’s area].

1. **[Main question or request].** Please confirm [specific conditions and the required answer or result] in [the area responsible for answering]. If [case A], we will [our action]; if [case B], we will [another action].
2. **[Only if there is an additional question].** [What needs to be considered together and why]. Delete this item if there is only one question.

[Which step is waiting for an answer, and whether an actual owner has been assigned and accepted responsibility]. Please include applicable conditions and the scope checked in the answer. Once we receive it, [requesting-side owner] will proceed with [next action]. If a deadline is needed, include the reason.
<!-- body:end -->
